dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Multiple 'O' and 'C' shaped structures are visible. Three smaller circular annuli located dorsally exhibit similar dark-to-light transitions with narrower boundaries.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Low-intensity solid pixel clusters are localized within the centers of the prominent annuli. These blobs show high core pixel concentration and lack internal gradients, with an increased spatial density along the dorsal midline.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Connecting the centroids of the largest mid-lateral annulus and the two most prominent dorsal annuli forms an obtuse scalene triangle. The geometric relationship is characterized by a wider angle at the dorsal-anterior centroid.
